candidates.original_title: Social perception in infancy: a near infrared spectroscopy study
candidates.description: Differential hemodynamic response in the posterior temporal cortex to social dynamic versus non-social dynamic stimuli in 5-month-old infants
candidates.citation_sentence: In the present study, we aim to replicate the results of Lloyd-Fox et al. (2009) and investigate the impact of infant Negative Affect (as measured by parental questionnaire) on the early cortical specialization for processing social dynamic stimuli.
candidates.notes: The paper explicitly states it aims to replicate Lloyd-Fox et al. (2009) Experiment 2 using identical stimuli and closely following its procedure. The authors confirm replication in the Discussion: 'We thus replicated the findings of Lloyd-Fox et al.'s study (2009).' The original study's N, effect sizes, and p-values are not reported in this paper, so those fields are left blank. The replication found the same effect (differential posterior temporal activation for social vs. non-social stimuli) but only in the right hemisphere, whereas the original reported bilateral activation; authors still explicitly state they replicated the findings.
